title: Realization of represented open ind-extension
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime l≠D.p, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, and finite-type k₀-schemes X₀,Y₀. Let j₀:X₀→Y₀ be a quasi-compact open immersion and let j be its geometric base change [def-zl-weil-geometric-fiber-properties]. Let S be any normalized compact-support coefficient action [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] for the compactification (j,id). For constructible Weil sheaves F on X₀ and G on Y₀ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], and any representation e:y_Y(G)≅j_!(y_X(F)) in the specified equivariant ind-category [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], there is an isomorphism G.carrier≅S(F.carrier) in the existing common-stage constructible category. There is no proper image, cohomology degree or composite compactification in this statement. No absolute separatedness is assumed.

source.document: SGA 4, XVII, §5.1; Bhatt–Scholze, Definition 6.7.6 and Lemma 6.7.7
source.place: Exact extension by zero, the open adjunction, and normalized completed coefficient realization.

proof.text: Retain the literal object formula in the proved construction of commonStageOpenHeartAdjunction. Take the coherent rational pullback stage morphism. At each coefficient field, rationalAdjunction supplies the finite compact-support left adjoint and its fully faithful unit; rational_standard supplies preservation of the standard classes. The normalized scalar isomorphisms put the target of each left mate in the essential image, so these actual mates are invertible. Use the proved StageLeftAdjunction.family, familyUnit, familyCounit and descendStageAdjunction helpers to descend this adjunction. The uniqueness specification identifies its right functor with the recorded common-stage pullback. The finite_eq clause of S identifies the descended functor H and S pointwise on literal output objects. Standard-class witnesses descend through the inclusion comparison, so H preserves the heart. Restrict H and its adjunction along the fully faithful heart inclusions. No absolute separatedness hypothesis is used.

Transport the restricted adjunction through AsSmall and use the proved zlIndMap_adjunction helper to extend it to ind-categories. The ind-Frobenius functors are equivalences. The inverse mate of the prescribed ind-pullback square is therefore invertible. Lift this adjunction to IsoAlgebra using its mate equation. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies this fixed-pair extension with zlIndWeilOpenShriek.

Compose the given representing isomorphism e with the preceding uniqueness isomorphism, and forget Frobenius. The Yoneda Kan unit identifies the resulting ind-extension of the represented input with Yoneda of the small heart extension. Fully faithful Yoneda reflects this isomorphism. Apply AsSmall.down and the heart inclusion, then use the recorded literal carrier equalities of zlWeilSmallPairs on F and G to obtain G.carrier isomorphic to H(F.carrier). Compose with the literal object equality H(F.carrier)=S.functor(F.carrier). This uses no separate representability assertion and includes zero objects and empty and identity opens.

proof_origin.place: P9: retain the literal object formula in the existing proved common-stage descent, then restrict to hearts, extend adjunctions to ind-objects and fixed pairs, and reflect the representing isomorphism through fully faithful Yoneda. No new unproved statement.

lean.statement:
theorem zlIndWeilOpenShriek_realization
    {X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (j₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [QuasiCompact j₀.left]
    (S : SfCompactSupportCoefficientAction l D.k (zlRealizationPrimeUnit D l hl) Ω
      (.ofIsOpenImmersion (zlFiberMap D j₀)))
    (F : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl X₀ Ω)
    (G : sfCommonStageWeilSheaf D l hl Y₀ Ω)
    (e : (zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω Y₀).obj G ≅
      (zlIndWeilOpenShriek D l hl Ω j₀).obj
        ((zlWeilIndEmbedding D l hl Ω X₀).obj F)) :
    Nonempty (G.obj.carrier ≅ S.system.functor.obj F.obj.carrier)
